body:
Code Review by Qodo


1. Issue comments can alter build reviews 🐞 Bug
>
>Description >
> >
>Item 7(c) selects the newest issue comment containing <!-- doc-mentions --> without checking who
>posted it or whether it belongs to the worker run. Anyone able to comment on the issue can post `Doc
>mentions: none to displace the worker’s report, or fabricate fixed` lines to make the reviewer
>fail a diff check.
>
>
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >The reviewer treats the newest marked issue comment as the worker’s report, even if someone else posted it. > >## Fix Focus Areas >- .claude/agents/build-reviewer.md[19-19] >- .claude/agents/pi-worker.md[21-21] > >## Recommended Fix >Have the reviewer accept only a comment from the expected Harness App, associated with the relevant worker run or PR, before using its `fixed`, `Debt:` or `none` entries. Treat other marked comments as untrusted rather than allowing them to replace the worker’s report. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >

View medium (1)
2. Older plans can skip the new docs check 🐞 Bug
>
>Description >
> >
>Item 7(c) adds a comment check but leaves item 7(b)’s instruction to judge only (a) when a plan
>lacks ### Docs. For an older plan without that section, the reviewer has conflicting directions
>and can pass the Docs item without checking the worker’s fixed lines.
>
>
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >The existing no-Docs-plan exception says to judge only part (a), contradicting the newly added part (c). > >## Fix Focus Areas >- .claude/agents/build-reviewer.md[19-19] > >## Recommended Fix >Change the exception to skip only part (b): when a plan has no `### Docs` section, judge both (a) and (c). >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
